beats.say: Carl Benz invented the first modern motor car in 1886.

label.s: inventor of the first modern motor car

beats.say: His gasoline-powered automobile was the first to be made in several identical copies, setting the stage for mass production.
But the journey started much earlier, with Hans Hautsch building a clockwork carriage in 1649.
In 1769, Nicolas Joseph Cugnot built the first steam-powered automobile capable of human transportation.
Samuel Brown tested the first industrially applied internal combustion engine in 1826.
And in 1908, the Ford Model T made cars affordable for everyone.
